caption:
Feel empty from giving? You were never the source. (1 Timothy 1:1–2 devotional)

Paul opens with grace, mercy, and peace — not things he generated, but things that flow from God through him to Timothy. You were never meant to be the reservoir; you're the channel grace passes through.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
